extracted.intended_audience: people who want to contribute new sequences or comments / edit entries in the OEIS (prospective OEIS contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for submitting a new integer sequence, editing an existing OEIS entry, or attaching data files/comments; includes account, signing, licensing, and format/procedure rules. Intended for prospective contributors to the OEIS database.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy standard
rubrics_metrics.description: Please take great care that the terms you send are absolutely correct. The standards are those of a mathematics reference work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Thousands of people use the sequence database every day. Since this is a scientific database, submissions must meet reference-work quality — double-check terms and correctness before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: No anonymous submissions / must register and log in
rubrics_metrics.description: Since this is a scientific database, anonymous submissions cannot be accepted. You must request an account and log in before you can contribute a new sequence or edit an existing one.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Account required for any contribution or edit; anonymous postings are not accepted due to the database's scientific/reference nature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sign your contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: You should always sign your contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you type four tildes, ~~~~, this will be replaced by your name, date, and a link to your user page where people can send you email without knowing your address. If you add a comment to a sequence, you can simply follow it with - ~~~~.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agree to Contributor's License Agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: By submitting anything to the OEIS you are agreeing that you have read and are bound by the OEIS Contributor's License Agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributors must read and accept the CLA (link provided on the page) as a condition of submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for contributing a new sequence
rubrics_metrics.description: Use this to contribute a sequence that is not at present in the OEIS. This is for submitting an unnumbered sequence; it will automatically be assigned an A-number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you would like to submit a collection of sequences that refer to each other, you can allocate the A-numbers first and then edit the sequences as if they were existing sequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for editing an existing sequence entry
rubrics_metrics.description: To add to or make changes to an existing entry for a sequence, log in and then visit that sequence's web page. Next to the sequence data you will see a link named 'edit,' which you can click to submit changes or additions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If someone else has already made changes that are not yet published, you will see a link named 'draft edits,' which will take you to the most recent draft of the sequence. From that page you can click 'edit' to make more changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitting large term lists via b-file
rubrics_metrics.description: Sending in a b-file or other file to be associated with a sequence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have more terms than will fit on three lines, you should consider sending them in the form of a b-file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the OEIS Style Sheet and Wiki guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: The OEIS Wiki has a lot of helpful advice, including a Style Sheet for Contributors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the OEIS Wiki and Style Sheet for advice on formatting, conventions, and other contributor best practices.
